1.name: H
1.text: Why, you look like you’ve been working hard every day!

2.name: H
2.text: Such a hard-working lady almost makes me proud! Hoho!

3.name: H
3.text: Oh boy, I’m too giddy today, aren’t I?

5.name: H
5.text: You know that talk we had the other day?

7.name: H
7.text: I thought I didn’t have that kind of motivation in me anymore, but…

9.name: H
9.text: To keep it short, I’ve decided to try and connect with my wife again.

10.name: H
10.text: She cut all ties with me when I went to prison, but I still know her phone number by heart, so I’ll give her a call.

11.name: H
11.text: I won’t demand for forgiveness or anything like that, but I want to at least know if my daughter is doing well.

12.name: H
12.text: …They are very dear to me. The both of them.

13.name: H
13.text: …And I probably missed a good few years of child support, huh?

14.name: H
14.text: I can’t deny I’m apprehensive, but being nervous will do no good..

15.name: H
15.text: When you doubt, you lift your head up and take each step at a time!

19.name: H
19.text: I’ll be gone for a few days, but I think you’re going to be fine.
